description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' implements the 'LogNode' interface and wraps Android's native Log utility. It provides a way to log messages with various priorities, tags, and optional Throwable exceptions, and supports chaining multiple LogNodes for output targeting.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface, enabling logging with chaining support.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain to which log data will be passed.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, optional Throwable, and passes the log to the next node if present.
